column1: #  - type T = ... and export type T<U> = ... are type_alias, whatever the right-hand side;
#  - function f, local function f and `local f = function` (at any depth) are functions; function M.f is a function named f; function M:m is a method named m;
#  - a top-level `f = function` / `M.f = function` is a function; a function-valued field of a table that is assigned or returned (3 levels, name or string key) is a function;
#  - a top-level local or global initialised with a table constructor is a variable, with or without a type annotation;
#  - return types, parameter types, other locals, non-function fields, anonymous functions and tables passed as call arguments are not definitions.
